record_type: sanitized derived evidence summary; not raw diagnostic logs
scope: OpenWrt routed policy and UDP DNAT

direct_observations.vpn_ipv6: link-local only; no IPv6 default route at inspection
direct_observations.dns_forwarding_evidence: Unique UDP/TCP client controls correlated with actual new-backend forward and completed reply entries; NOERROR/NODATA interpreted as NODATA, not an A-answer claim.
direct_observations.wired_public_https: HTTPS to 1.1.1.1 returned 301 with source 10.100.20.20; route selected eth0 via 10.100.20.1
direct_observations.fw4_standalone_checker: Permission denied through available RPC; NOT claimed as passed; no bypass used
direct_observations.firewall_alternative_validation: Authorized native nftables JSON readback of ingress, exact DNAT, forwarding acceptance, saved state, and regression traffic tests
direct_observations.nov10_host_side_checks: Unbound UDP/TCP and Pi-hole control queries answered; IPv4 forwarding enabled; DNS-independent HTTPS from VPN-01 to 1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace returned 200. Not a forwarded phone traffic measurement.

operator_or_screenshot_evidence.remote_nas_access: Operator reported success after instruction to test from cellular with WireGuard enabled; independently instrumented handshake not captured
operator_or_screenshot_evidence.phone_ssh: Operator later reported success and cancelled proposed phone-only access change; exact earlier refusal cause unconfirmed; no extra phone firewall/reservation/key changes made
operator_or_screenshot_evidence.vpn_client_dns_resolution: Operator identified the retired DNS-server address in the phone WireGuard profile, updated it to the new DNS-server address, and reported that internet access then worked. Intended VPN DNS endpoint: Pi-hole 192.16810.100.20.10. No additional server restart/firewall/key change was needed.

automated_tests.integration_boundary: Service commands/clocks injected in unit tests; live service/network integration checked separately after operator apply

not_claimed_verified: independently instrumented external VPN routing, IPv6 and throughput assessment
fresh independently captured external WireGuard handshake/counters
quantified MTTR, downtime, availability percentage, RTO or RPO

address_sanitization.note: Direct-observation fields preserve outcomes but use substituted addresses. Public test endpoint and standard loopback notation are unchanged.
